# Bug Report

Thank you for taking the time to report a bug in Symtab.

Before creating a new issue:

- Search existing issues to make sure the bug has not already been reported.
- Make sure you are using the latest version or latest available commit.
- If possible, reproduce the issue consistently before submitting the report.
- Provide enough information for someone else to reproduce the problem.
